features.name: Model selector
features.purpose: Pick which Claude model a session or workflow step runs with, shown with a one-line description per option.
businessRules: description is optional on ModelOption; missing description renders label-only
architecturalRules: all model Selects must use modelSelectData()/renderModelOption instead of inlining data mapping

features.name: Session sidebar usage display
features.purpose: Show per-session cost, token spend, and EU-formatted date in the sidebar session list.
businessRules: cost rendered as $X.XX, hidden when totalCostUsd is unset
token icon/tooltip hidden when totalTokens is unset
date rendered en-GB (dd/mm/yyyy) instead of browser-default locale
architecturalRules: totalTokens accumulates on the SDK result message the same way totalCostUsd already does, rather than introducing a separate tracking mechanism

features.name: Workflow step update popover
features.purpose: Warn when a pinned workflow step is behind its published version, show a field diff, and let the user update to the latest version.
businessRules: diff list scrolls independently (ScrollArea.Autosize, mah 280) once it exceeds popover height, so the Update button stays reachable regardless of diff length

features.name: Workflow stop advances
features.purpose: Pressing Stop while a workflow step is running marks it done and auto-advances to the next step instead of parking at waiting-approval.
businessRules: plain Stop during a running workflow step always advances; no toggle
a user prompt sent before the interrupted turn settles clears the 'interrupted' flag
step output hand-off after Stop is whatever the model last said (partial by design)
architecturalRules: never advance synchronously on interrupt — flag advanceOnComplete and wait for the turn to settle
the handleWorkerEnded settle fallback must stay gated on the interrupting set (routine non-error ended events exist)
